conditions.name: Night Raid
loot_effects: In-game description: 'Raiders have been finding especially good loot behind locked doors, and keys have been more plentiful.'
In-game bullets: Increased loot value; Fewer active Return Points; No active Raider Hatches
Since 2.3.0 (official): Dolabra, Bobcat, Equalizer, Jupiter, Tempest and Vulcano blueprints can drop in any major condition (that pool's drop chance was slightly lowered)

Wiki blueprint table (unconfirmed): Wolfpack blueprint drops only in Night Raid; tier-III attachment blueprints (Angled Grip III, Compensator III, Extended Barrel III, Extended Light/Medium/Shotgun Mag III, Muzzle Brake III, Shotgun Choke III, Stable Stock III, Vertical Grip III, Lightweight Stock) drop only in Electromagnetic Storm, Locked Gate or Night Raid; Padded Stock and Shotgun Silencer also drop in Hidden Bunker
Wiki editorial with no official source: more containers spawn, and more ARC cells and cores drop (Advanced ARC Powercell, Bastion Cell, etc.)
arc_effects: In-game description: 'The heightened Raider activity has attracted more ARC than usual.'
1.22.0 (official): more variety of Leaper, Bombardier, Bastion and Rocketeer spawns during Night Raid
conditions.source: off_tracker; wiki_conditions; off_2.3.0; off_1.22.0; off_1.33.0; wiki_blueprints
notes: Free loadouts are disabled (1.33.0; it began as a 3-week experiment and the wiki still lists it)

Map list comes from wiki infoboxes. The official 40-hour schedule window showed only Dam, Buried City, Spaceport, Stella Montis and Pendola Pass, so Blue Gate and Riven Tides are unconfirmed for the current rotation
Per the wiki, Stella Montis runs only Normal and Night Raid

conditions.name: Electromagnetic Storm
loot_effects: In-game bullets: Increased loot value; Fewer active Return Points; No active Raider Hatches; Lightning strikes
More crashed Probes and Couriers (wiki)
Fossilized Lightning appears where lightning strikes; it salvages or recycles into Explosive Compound (wiki)
Since 2.3.0 (official): Dolabra, Bobcat, Equalizer, Jupiter, Tempest and Vulcano blueprints can drop in any major condition (that pool's drop chance was slightly lowered)

Wiki blueprint table (unconfirmed): Snap Hook and Surge Coil blueprints drop only in EMS; tier-III attachment blueprints (Angled Grip III, Compensator III, Extended Barrel III, Extended Light/Medium/Shotgun Mag III, Muzzle Brake III, Shotgun Choke III, Stable Stock III, Vertical Grip III, Lightweight Stock) drop only in Electromagnetic Storm, Locked Gate or Night Raid
1.13.0 (official): fewer container types can spawn condition-specific blueprints during EMS, Hidden Bunker and Locked Gate
arc_effects: Lightning can instantly destroy small ARC and briefly disable large ARC; flying ARC such as Rocketeers fall from the sky (wiki)
notes: The official 40-hour window showed only Dam Battlegrounds

conditions.name: Hurricane
loot_effects: In-game bullets: Increased loot value; Debris affects Shields; Higher-threat ARC
First Wave Caches spawn and give better loot than normal Raider Caches; the wiki says players report tier IV weapons and rare blueprints
1.18.0 (official): rare blueprint drop rate in First Wave Caches slightly lowered, high-tier material drop rate raised
Wiki blueprint table (unconfirmed): the Canto blueprint drops only in Hurricane, from First Wave Caches
Since 2.3.0 (official): Dolabra, Bobcat, Equalizer, Jupiter, Tempest and Vulcano blueprints can drop in any major condition (that pool's drop chance was slightly lowered)
arc_effects: 'Higher-threat ARC', and the wiki says the storm draws more ARC
notes: The official 40-hour window showed only Buried City

conditions.name: Cold Snap
loot_effects: In-game bullets: Harvest Candleberries; Increased loot value; Damaging cold
Raider Caches have better loot and must be breached (wiki)
Fireworks Box blueprint: the wiki says Cold Snap only, but MetaForge says it is in the Industrial pool and still dropped after Cold Snap ended (Jan 2026). The two sources conflict
notes: Not on the official tracker's condition list on 2026-11-08, so it is out of rotation
Seasonal: added 1.7.0 (2025-12-16), removed 1.11.0, re-added 1.15.0. The wiki calls it major; there is no official type because it is off the tracker

conditions.name: Hidden Bunker
loot_effects: In-game bullets: Fewer active Return Points; No active Raider Hatches; Activate Rooftop Antennas; Retrieve data from the bunker
The bunker is west/southwest of the Departure Building. Activate 4 rooftop antennas (progress is shared by the lobby), then download data at 8 terminals inside, each usable once (wiki)
Wiki blueprint table (unconfirmed): Padded Stock and Shotgun Silencer blueprints
Since 2.3.0 (official): Dolabra, Bobcat, Equalizer, Jupiter, Tempest and Vulcano blueprints can drop in any major condition (that pool's drop chance was slightly lowered)
arc_effects: The first interaction with each antenna spawns Wasps and Hornets; two Bastions and a Bombardier patrol the bunker entrances (wiki)
notes: Raids last 40 minutes
The official tracker lists it as major but showed no scheduled occurrences on 2026-11-08

conditions.name: Locked Gate
loot_effects: In-game bullets: Fewer active Return Points; No active Raider Hatches; Collect Security Codes
Opens the underground tunnels at Checkpoint. Take 4 security codes (Raider's Refuge, Pilgrim's Peak, Reinforced Reception, Ancient Fort) to the Gate Control Room console (wiki)

Wiki blueprint table (unconfirmed): tier-III attachment blueprints (Angled Grip III, Compensator III, Extended Barrel III, Extended Light/Medium/Shotgun Mag III, Muzzle Brake III, Shotgun Choke III, Stable Stock III, Vertical Grip III, Lightweight Stock) drop only in Electromagnetic Storm, Locked Gate or Night Raid
Since 2.3.0 (official): Dolabra, Bobcat, Equalizer, Jupiter, Tempest and Vulcano blueprints can drop in any major condition (that pool's drop chance was slightly lowered)
arc_effects: Two Rocketeers guard Pilgrim's Peak; Buried Mines surround each code location (wiki)
notes: Raids last 40 minutes

conditions.name: Close Scrutiny
loot_effects: In-game bullets: No active locked doors (key rooms open without a key; puzzle rooms stay locked); Decreased overall loot value; Increased ARC loot
Surveyors, guarded by Vaporizers, call in ARC Assessors. Breach an Assessor's pylons for Assessor Matrix and other ARC loot (wiki)
arc_effects: Starting a pylon breach spawns a swarm of flying ARC: Vaporizers, Rocketeers, Fireflies, Hornets and Wasps (wiki)
notes: ARC Operation. Free loadouts disabled (1.33.0)
The official 40-hour window showed Dam and Buried City

conditions.name: ARC Frigate
loot_effects: In-game bullets: No active locked doors; Decreased overall loot value; No active Raider Hatches

Frigate containers hold mid-tier ARC loot with a small chance of Amplification Modules, Frigate Inductors and ARC Data. The final Cargo has a much higher rate of Frigate Diagnostic Nodes, Amplification Modules and other amplification parts (wiki)
2.3.0 (official): areas further inside the Frigate have a higher chance of higher-tier rewards
Since 2.3.0 (official): Dolabra, Bobcat, Equalizer, Jupiter, Tempest and Vulcano blueprints can drop in any major condition (that pool's drop chance was slightly lowered)
arc_effects: Surface ARC spawns are greatly reduced and ARC Turbines do not spawn (wiki)
Hydras, Rocketeers, Vaporizers, Fireflies, Hornets and Wasps defend the Frigate (wiki)
notes: ARC Operation; raids last 35 minutes; no free loadout (wiki)
The official window showed Buried City, Dam, Pendola Pass, Spaceport and Blue Gate. Riven Tides comes from the wiki only

conditions.name: Harvester
loot_effects: Finishing the Harvester core sequence (3 fusion cores, then 12 yellow targets) guarantees 1 to 3 Equalizer or Jupiter blueprints (wiki)
The Harvester's breachable containers drop ARC materials such as ARC Alloy, Advanced ARC Powercell and Impure ARC Coolant (wiki)
notes: The official tracker classes it as minor

conditions.name: Matriarch
loot_effects: The Matriarch drops high-tier ARC materials, including Advanced ARC Powercell, ARC Motion Core, Magnetic Accelerator, Matriarch Reactor and ARC Insulated Coupler (wiki)
2.0 (official): higher-tier loot moved from the leg armour to the leg pieces on the Queen and Matriarch
1.7.0 (official): the Aphelion blueprint drop moved from the Matriarch to Stella Montis
arc_effects: Spawns the Matriarch with defending ARC 'children' (official description)
notes: The official tracker classes it as minor

conditions.name: Uncovered Caches
loot_effects: Many more Raider Caches, which explode if left too long, and their loot value is increased (wiki)
Raider Caches hold ammo, blueprints, grenades, healing items, shields, quick-use items and weapons (wiki)
notes: The official tracker lists it as minor; the overview data held one Buried City occurrence, but its condition page showed none scheduled

conditions.name: Prospecting Probes
loot_effects: Many more Probes, which are ARC loot containers (wiki)
arc_effects: Probes are more often guarded by flying ARC such as Wasps (wiki)

conditions.name: Lush Blooms
loot_effects: More Nature loot and Wicker Baskets (wiki)

conditions.name: Husk Graveyard
loot_effects: Many more Wasp, Rocketeer and Courier husks to loot, and they can be electrified when breached. Baron Husks are unchanged (wiki)
notes: Not on the official tracker list on 2026-11-08, so probably out of rotation

conditions.name: Bird City
loot_effects: More trinkets in rooftop chimney nests, including Duck trinkets found only in this condition (wiki)
1.17.0 (official): slightly lower chance of rare loot in chimneys
arc_effects: Many more ARC drones of all types patrol the sky (wiki)
notes: Extra ziplines are placed

conditions.name: Beachcombing
loot_effects: Dig on the north beaches with a Dockmaster's Detector for Weapon Cases, Suitcases (basic materials, ship models) and fruit or fertilizer. Some digs turn up mines or Ticks (wiki)

conditions.name: Launch Tower Loot
loot_effects: Extra loot at the top of the Launch Tower. To open the zipline doors, put a fuel cell into the generator at their base (wiki)
1.22.0 (official): higher chance of high-tier loot from finishing the rooftop activity
arc_effects: Official description: ARC 'ramped up their defenses'
notes: Not on the official tracker list on 2026-11-08, so probably out of rotation

conditions.name: Redirection
loot_effects: In-game bullets: No Flash Freeze; Emperor Relays active; Falling Debris
Loot and deploy Emperor Beacons to call down Harvester Payloads, breachable containers with ARC materials and parts (wiki)
Payloads can drop the Emperor Gateway Conduit blueprint. 2.3.0 (official) lowered that chance and added a small chance of ARC parts and high-tier ARC loot instead
notes: The official tracker classes it as minor

rarity_rules.rule: Container tier (none, yellow, red) raises the chance of higher-rarity loot but does not guarantee it

Loot tables depend on location: the same container yields loot of its zone type (Residential, Industrial, Medical, Security, Electrical, Commercial, Technological, ARC, Raider, Nature, Exodus, Old World). Not every container type adapts. MetaForge tags containers with the same zone types
Pendola Pass Dynamic Loot Zones: a zone's value changes each raid, its loot type stays fixed
Locked-room loot value rises with key rarity (1.22.0 raised all locked rooms on that scale; 1.7.0 raised Epic key rooms)
Fewer weapons spawn on map outskirts. Outskirt weapons can spawn at around 15 durability, versus about 60 in locked rooms
Night Raid, Electromagnetic Storm, Cold Snap and Hurricane show 'Increased loot value' in game. Night Raid's description stresses loot behind locked doors and more keys
ARC Operations (Close Scrutiny, ARC Frigate) show 'Decreased overall loot value' and open all key-locked rooms. Close Scrutiny adds ARC loot; the Frigate has its own containers and Cargo
Dolabra, Bobcat, Equalizer, Jupiter, Tempest and Vulcano blueprints drop in any major condition; that pool's drop chance was slightly lowered

The wiki says 'Blueprints for rare and epic items are more commonly found during x2 Major Map Conditions', with no source and no multiplier. Several third-party sites say the '2x' tag on major conditions means double Trials points, not double loot. Do not model this as 2x blueprints

Some blueprints are condition-only: tier-III attachments (EMS, Locked Gate, Night Raid); Wolfpack (Night Raid); Snap Hook and Surge Coil (EMS); Canto (Hurricane First Wave Caches); Fireworks Box (Cold Snap, disputed by MetaForge). Others are map-only: Stella Montis, Riven Tides, and Stella Montis plus Blue Gate for Mk.3 augments. The wiki says its spawn data is not fully confirmed

Blueprint families follow container type: weapons and gun parts in Raider containers, explosives in Industrial, medical in Medical, augments in Security (rarely Medical), utilities in Electrical, attachments in Residential
1.13.0 reduced the container types that can spawn condition-specific blueprints in EMS, Hidden Bunker and Locked Gate
Fallen Emperor and ARC Frigate: higher-tier loot sits deeper inside

Since 1.42.0 schedules are regional. The official tracker runs conditions in 1-hour slots per map, offset by region (north-america, brazil, east-asia, oceania, ...). In-game countdowns appear only 60 minutes before a condition starts (1.33.0)
